prompt: Please organize the invoices in the current folder for tax preparation. For each invoice (PDF or JPG), extract the invoice date, vendor name, and product/service description. Rename every file to the exact format "YYYY-MM-DD Vendor - Invoice - Description.ext" (preserving original extension). Then organize the renamed files into folders by vendor name. Finally, create a CSV file named "invoice-summary.csv" listing: Date, Vendor, Invoice Number (if available), Description, Amount (if available), Category (leave blank if unknown), and File Path (relative to current directory). Keep the original files untouched and copy the renamed files into the organized folder structure. Please ensure all filenames and folder names have no special characters except hyphens and spaces. Capitalize vendor names properly. Use dates from the invoice text, not from filenames, and if missing use file modification date. This is a simple, straightforward organization task with a small set of test invoices.
